scope: Tag-only grounded content repair, distinct from the background-only L1 contract approval. No change to L0 tags quality criteria.

authorization.user_task: Parent-reported original request to resolve all defects and continue until success authorizes grounded content repair of independently found tag insufficiencies.
authorization.background_contract_not_expanded: The hash-bound L1 approval modifies background evaluation only; it does not authorize relaxation of tags or other fields. This repair is content enrichment against unchanged L0 tags level2 (>=3 concrete problem words), not a rubric amendment.

helper_assessment.allowed_edits: Only extend existing tags with 1-3 distinct independently proposed words per affected card, retaining prior order/values.
helper_assessment.grounding: Candidate field value must equal actual existing string, and candidate is a strict substring. For background candidates the helper uses old_background in pinned context draft to avoid new synthesized background becoming its own evidence. Field string SHA is recorded.
helper_assessment.preflight: All candidates/schema validated before source writes; tags must equal independent findings tags_before. Source bytes checked again before first write.
helper_assessment.preservation_scope: all_other_fields_preserved is relative to tag-stage input only. Earlier background stage changes background, so the whole continuation does not preserve all fields. Card IDs, ordering, file metadata/count, non-tags and original tags are preserved by the tag stage.
helper_assessment.semantic_adequacy_not_automatically_prov: Substring proves text support, not concrete issue-selector adequacy. Helper explicitly emits independent adequacy review required.
helper_assessment.serialization_condition: Run only after background-writer freeze, regenerate preview at that frozen snapshot, pin exact plan/helper/inventory/draft and execute without concurrent KB writers.
helper_assessment.limits: Preflight is not a multi-file transaction/lock. No all-or-nothing write-failure receipt claimed; inspect post-application migration and actual files.
